scenarios.name: Stage the same command on two ribbon targets

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible
the Part Tools and Part Manage custom panel lists are initially empty
the Ribbon customization dialog shows Part Tools and All Commands
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part Tools custom panel
"2D Sketches" appears in the Part Tools custom panel list
"2D Sketches" is absent from the visible available commands list
the user selects the Part Manage target
its custom panel list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part Manage custom panel
"2D Sketches" appears in the Part Manage custom panel list
the target indicates a pending change
the user returns to the Part Tools target
"2D Sketches" remains in its custom panel list
the target indicates a pending change
no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
